title: Beatrix and the Drop
author: Yara Lockridge
blurb: Quentin Okafor, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
